label: PF Backlog 477
title: Hook: a NEW dependency (manifest diff) must have a tool-catalog entry, else pre-check fails (BI-0211 completeness split)
body:
Source: BI-0211 delivery split (2026-10-08) + user request. BI-0211 built the catalog + a gate that
validates the catalog's INTERNAL consistency; this item builds the COMPLETENESS hook: a change that ADDS a
dependency must also add a catalog entry, else pre-check fails.

Goal: close the loophole where code adds a third-party dependency (requirements/pyproject/go.mod/package.json)
without a license/bundle record - so packaging+bundle decisions stay provable.

DESIGN (proposed; approval before code):
- scripts/dev/dependency_catalog_check.py - CHANGED-FILE scoped (mirrors scripts/dev/store_check.py: diff vs
  merge-base + working tree). Parses PF's OWN manifests only (product-forge/requirements*.txt, pyproject.toml
  [PEP 621 project.dependencies], workergrid/go.mod [require], .opencode/package.json) - NOT products/archive.
- Added dependency names (old vs new) must resolve via core.tool_catalog.lookup(name) (normalized). Missing ->
  FAIL with the exact names to register.
- Wire into precheck (fast tier) + the pre-commit hook (early feedback).
- Fail-closed; escape only via a documented `PF_ALLOW_UNCATALOGUED=1` (emergencies), never silent.

API-FIRST REVIEW: no NEW API required - the catalog is already read-exposed via
GET /api/v1/tools/catalog[/{name}] (BI-0211); this is an author-time/CI gate, not a client surface. (Call this
out explicitly to satisfy the API-first check.)

depends_on: BI-0211 (catalog). related: BI-0205 (precheck/PR infra).
